learning_outcomes.text: Explain how loads flow through a structure from application to the foundation
Distinguish dead, live, wind, seismic and other load types and how they combine
Describe the behaviour of beams, columns, trusses and frames under load
Interpret basic stress, strain and material strength concepts for steel and concrete
Identify common structural systems and when each is used
Recognise the limits of hand reasoning and when a licensed engineer and analysis are required

integrative_case: A small two-storey steel-framed office is being planned: trace the gravity and lateral load paths, identify the members and systems carrying each load, and mark the points where a licensed structural engineer must perform the analysis before anything is built.

case-based decisions in the integrative case
